device_transmitter_description.title: EW-Sender Lernen
device_transmitter_description.description:
🎛️ **EW-Sender Lernen**

**📋 Gerätedaten:**
• Name: EW-Sender #{sender_index}
• Tasten: {button_count}
• Modus: {operating_type}-Tast-Bedienung

**📡 Lernprozess:**
Drücken Sie eine beliebige Taste auf dem EW-Sender, wenn das Lernen gestartet wird.

🔴 **Wichtig:** Halten Sie den EW-Sender bereit!

device_sensor_description.title: EWneo-Sensor Lernen
device_sensor_description.description:
🌡️ **EWneo-Sensor Lernen**

**📋 Gerätetyp:** EWneo-Sensor (Temperatur/Feuchte/Wetter)

📊 **Auto-Erkennung:**
• 🌡️ Temperatursensor
• 💧 Feuchtesensor
• ☔ Regensensor
• 💨 Windsensor
• 🔋 Batteriestatus

🔴 **Wichtig:** Drücken Sie die Lerntaste am EWneo-Sensor, wenn das Lernen gestartet wird!

progress_action.waiting_for_sensor_telegram: 🔄 Warte auf Lernsignal... Drücken Sie JETZT die Lerntaste am EWneo-Sensor!

device_ewneo_receiver.title: Add EWneo-Switch/Motor
device_ewneo_receiver.description:
🔌 **Add EWneo-Switch/Motor**

You can add an EWneo-Switch/Motor to Home Assistant.

**📋 Overview:**
• EWneo devices are controlled bidirectionally via the gateway
• Supports switches, dimmers, and motors
• Status feedback from the device

**📡 Learning process:**

**1.** System prepares the connection
**2.** Press the learn button on the EWneo device
**3.** Device is automatically detected and added

🔴 **Important:** Have the EWneo device with learn button ready!

device_ewneo_receiver_prepare.title: Preparing EWneo-Switch/Motor
device_ewneo_receiver_prepare.description:
🔧 **Preparing EWneo switch/motor...**

📋 **Preparation steps:**
• Determining EWneo index
• Loading gateway serial number
• Setting receive filter

⚡ **Please wait a moment...**

device_ewneo_receiver_description.title: EWneo-Transceiver Learning - Instructions
device_ewneo_receiver_description.description:
🔌 **EWneo-Transceiver Learning**

**📋 Device data:**
• 🔢 EWneo-Index: {ewneo_index}
• 🔑 Gateway Serial: {gateway_serial}

**📋 Device type:** EWneo-Switch/Motor (Bidirectional)

**📡 Learning process:**

**1.** Click 'Start'
**2.** Press the learn button on the EWneo device
**3.** System waits 30 seconds for the signal
**4.** Device is automatically added

⚡ **What will be created:**
• One EWneo-Transceiver device
• Switch/Dimmer/Motor entity
• Status feedback from the device

🔴 **Important:** Have the EWneo device with learn button ready!

device_ewneo_receiver_learn.title: Learning EWneo-Switch/Motor
device_ewneo_receiver_learn.description:
🔗 **Learning EWneo switch/motor...**

🔴 **Press the LEARN BUTTON on your EWneo device NOW!**

📡 **The system is sending connection requests...**

• The LED on the device should be blinking
• Connection attempts are repeated automatically
• Timeout: 30 seconds

⚡ **Status:** Waiting for device response...

device_ewneo_receiver_learn_wait.title: Learning EWneo-Switch/Motor
device_ewneo_receiver_learn_wait.description:
🔄 **No response yet**

🔴 **Press the LEARN BUTTON on your EWneo device!**

Choose an option:

device_ewneo_receiver_learn_start.title: Start EWneo-Transceiver Learning
device_ewneo_receiver_learn_start.description:
🔴 **Press the LEARN BUTTON on your EWneo device NOW!**

� **Device data:**
• 🔢 EWneo-Index: {ewneo_index}
• 🔑 Gateway Serial: ...{gateway_serial}

📡 Click 'Submit' to start the learning process.

• The system will send JOIN requests for up to 30 seconds
• The LED on the device should blink when ready
• Press and hold the learn button on the EWneo device

device_ewneo_receiver_learn_progress.title: Learning EWneo-Switch/Motor
device_ewneo_receiver_learn_progress.description:
🔗 **Learning EWneo switch/motor...**

🔴 **Press the LEARN BUTTON on your EWneo device NOW!**

📡 **The system is sending connection requests...**

• Connection attempts are repeated automatically
• Timeout: 30 seconds

⚡ **Status:** Waiting for device response...

device_ewneo_receiver_learn_timeout.title: Timeout
device_ewneo_receiver_learn_timeout.description:
⏰ **No response received**

The system did not receive a valid response. You can try again.

device_ewneo_receiver_learning_mode.title: Put EWneo-Transceiver in Learning Mode
device_ewneo_receiver_learning_mode.description:
🔗 **EWneo-Transceiver Learning Mode**

**🔴 Press the LEARN BUTTON on the EWneo device NOW!**

📡 The system is waiting for the device's learning mode.

• The LED on the device should be blinking
• Timeout: 30 seconds

⚡ **Status:** Waiting for learning mode confirmation...

waiting_for_transmitter_telegram.title: 📡 EW-Sender Learning
waiting_for_transmitter_telegram.description:
**🔴 Press ANY button on the EW-Sender NOW**

🔄 **Waiting for radio signal...**

⏳ The system is waiting up to 30 seconds for the telegram.

📊 After successful reception, device information will be displayed and you can confirm the device.

❌ You can cancel the process at any time.

waiting_for_sensor_telegram.title: 🌡️ EWneo-Sensor Learning
waiting_for_sensor_telegram.description:
**🔴 Press the LEARN button on the EWneo-Sensor NOW**

🔄 **Waiting for learn telegram...**

⏳ The system is waiting up to 30 seconds for the learn telegram.

📊 Available sensors will be automatically detected and displayed.

📊 After successful reception, sensor information will be displayed and you can confirm the sensor.

❌ You can cancel the process at any time.

waiting_for_ewneo_join.title: 🔗 EWneo-Switch/Motor Learning
waiting_for_ewneo_join.description:
**🔴 Press the LEARN BUTTON on the EWneo device NOW!**

🔄 **Sending connection requests...**

📡 The system is sending repeated EWB_JOIN_DEVICE commands.

⏳ Timeout: 30 seconds

💡 **Tip:** The LED on the device should be blinking.

❌ You can cancel the process at any time.
